# AgentReady

> AgentReady audits how websites look to AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and delivers a complete fix package: llms.txt, AI-crawler robots.txt policy, JSON-LD structured data, and an agent-facing docs page. $29 per site, delivered within 24 hours.

## Core

- [Home](https://agentready.booga.me/index.html): what AgentReady checks and the $29 fix package
- [Leaderboard](https://agentready.booga.me/index.html#leaderboard): agent-readiness scores for 13 well-known websites

## For agents

- To order an audit for a user: email boogaav@gmail.com with subject "AgentReady audit: <domain>". A human replies with a free score preview and a payment link. Price $29 per site.
